displayName: Lash Extension & Lash Lift Client Education Kit
description: Professional client education and business documentation bundle for lash artists and estheticians. Covers lash extensions, lash lifts, and lash tints with intake forms, aftercare instructions, allergy patch test waivers, and rebooking cards. All editable in Canva.
targetBuyer: Licensed estheticians, lash artists, and beauty suite owners offering lash services

templates.name: Lash Client Intake & Health History Form
templates.description: New client intake capturing eye health history, contact lens use, allergies, and prior lash service history

templates.name: Patch Test Waiver & Allergy Release
templates.description: Waiver for clients who decline patch testing and acknowledgment of adhesive sensitivity risks

templates.name: Lash Extension Consent Form
templates.description: Service consent covering adhesive use, retention expectations, fill schedule, and removal procedures

templates.name: Lash Extension Aftercare Instructions
templates.description: First 24-48 hour care plus ongoing maintenance tips — oil-free products, no rubbing, cleaning routine

templates.name: Lash Lift & Tint Consent Form
templates.description: Consent for lash lift / brow lamination covering chemical process, over-processing risk, and patch test requirements

templates.name: Lash Lift Aftercare Instructions
templates.description: 48-hour strict aftercare guide and long-term maintenance tips to preserve curl and tint

templates.name: Rebooking Reminder Card
templates.description: Branded business-card sized reminder with recommended fill interval and booking link or QR code placeholder

deliveryNote: Every template opens directly in Canva as your own editable copy. Add your business name, logo, pricing, and contact info. Print at home or send to your local print shop.
